name: boxbrain-v2
description: Governed enterprise slide and content catalog for BoxBrain v2.

scripts.backend:lint: cd services/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.backend:typecheck: cd services/api && uv run mypy --explicit-package-bases app
scripts.verify: pnpm openapi:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm backend:lint && pnpm backend:typecheck && pnpm backend:test
scripts.openapi:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='contracts/openapi/boxbrain.v2.yaml';const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(!/^openapi: 3\\.1\\.0/m.test(s)){throw new Error('Expected OpenAPI 3.1 contract at '+p)}"
